name: The adventure of Bacon
source:
The cheerful adventures of a little piggy that loves to explore and his first experience in the world outside the farm.

A children book with simple drawings and easy lecture that all ages will enjoy.
translation:
一只爱探索的小猪的欢乐冒险，以及他第一次体验农场外的世界。

一本儿童读物，配有简单的图画和简单的讲座，所有年龄段的人都会喜欢。
